verdict.rationale: Airbyte offers multiple headless/CI paths: a REST API with token auth for programmatic control (usable with orchestrators like Airflow), an official Terraform provider for config-as-code automation, PyAirbyte for scripted/Python pipelines, and abctl/Docker/Kubernetes deployment options suited to CI environments. missing for 10: no dedicated CI-specific docs/examples (e.g. GitHub Actions recipe) and no independent hands-on confirmation of running Airbyte fully headless in a CI pipeline.
